textSegments: Compliance with ATX12V V3.1(SFX12V V4.0 for 750W & 850W)
MIA IC (Multiple Intelligence Ability) chip set inside
Quiet and long-lasting 92mm ball bearing fan
Circuit protections OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP
Updated ATX 3.1 specifications for the next-generation hardware power demands and ensure users get the most stable and cost-optimized performance possible with the highest power efficiency.
The DAGGER PRO(ATX3.1) series is compatible with most Mini-ITX and Micro ATX small form factor PCs. It is an ideal for home computer rigs but a great alternative for mini-PC enthusiasts.
Advance Cable Management and Flat Ribbon Cables
Fully-modular design and flat ribbon cables provide easier installation. An ideal solution for applications with space constraints, enhancing overall airflow efficiency and cable management.
DAGGER PRO(ATX3.1) series is included an advanced semi-fanless design that will spin over 20% loading, make silent and reduce noise under maximum operation.

DAGGER PRO(ATX3.1) series is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and as a result to reduce lots of electricity cost.
Powerful +12V Single Rail for your Graphics Cards

Graphics card is a component which needs greedy and stable power supporting most. The compact size DAGGER PRO(ATX3.1) series comes with a single +12V rail design that offers graphics cards full power individually and to avoid any overloading conditions.
The DAGGER PRO(ATX3.1) series comes with a native PCIe 5.1 connector for the latest graphics cards and features dual CPU power connectors to support high-end motherboards for gaming enthusiasts.
DAGGER PRO(ATX3.1) series uses Japanese electrolytic capacitors to ensure a longer lifetime and protect your PSU from sudden power change!
Adapts to your individual requirements, not only does it fit into cases with the SFX form factor, but can also be installed in a simple steps into normal ATX, Micro-ATX or Mini-ITX cases.
